label: nothing
what: My experience does not establish any undisclosed joint preparation. Vague bridge/port-change and decoration rumours lack concrete firsthand details; the neighbour traced what he actually heard to Freight offering ordinary wheat collection and bread delivery to the baker. The baker asked whether any gatherings needed bread, while the neighbour and secretary reported none confirmed. I cannot identify participants or knowing helpers, or say what would be being prepared. Ordinary trade is supported, not a secret event or infrastructure project.
